development: Development build — not for clinical decisions
sofa_note: Respiratory, cardiovascular, hepatic and renal only. Exclude coagulation and GCS.
dimer_unit: Shared D-dimer result and ULN unit
dimer_basis: Shared D-dimer result and ULN basis
comparable: Confirmed: result and ULN use the same assay, units and FEU/DDU basis
condition: Underlying condition capable of causing DIC
special_warning: Standard criteria may not apply: a specialized approach is required.
insufficient: Insufficient data. Check format, ranges, units and comparability.
sic_not: Numerical SIC criteria not met; coagulopathy is not excluded.
sic_context: Clinical SIC interpretation requires established sepsis.
dic_met: ISTH threshold reached; score consistent with overt DIC in an appropriate clinical context.
dic_not: Overt DIC threshold not reached; DIC is not excluded. Reassess over time if clinical suspicion persists.
dic_context: Without an appropriate underlying condition, this result does not confirm DIC.
negative_pt: Patient PT is shorter than control: check input and control. PT score = 0.
breakdown: Components in field order; total and threshold flag:
about_body:
